title: Lab incidents surfaced months after they happened
caption: Each dot is one of 55 incidents, stacked by month. Switch the dial to move each dot from when it happened to when it became public. Filled dots are confirmed by the operator or affected party, hollow ones attributed or disputed, dotted ones self-reported.
notes: 10 incidents have no published incident date, so they only appear in the 'became public' view.
Data: the A01 incident log. Lane colours match A01 (labs blue, companies orange, individuals aqua).
